source_dir.description: The directory containing the source JPG/PNG/GIF images to process.

dest_dir.description: Subdirectory relative to source_dir where HTML/CSS/thumbnails are placed. Empty means same directory.

index_file.description: Name of the main thumbnail index file generated by igal2.

width.description: Number of images wide (columns) in the thumbnail index table.

height.description: Height in pixels of the thumbnails.

xy.description: Scale thumbnails to n pixels along their longest dimension. 0 to disable.

padding.description: Cellpadding value (in pixels) for the thumbnail index table.

pagination.description: Maximum number of images on one page. 0 means no pagination.

show_dims.description: Write image dimensions and sizes under each thumbnail.

show_captions.description: Write image captions under each thumbnail on the index page.

slide_titles_from_name.description: Use image file names for the HTML slide titles instead of captions/defaults.

slide_names_from_file.description: Name slide files after the image file name instead of 1.html, 2.html, etc.

no_filmreel.description: Omit the film reel effect on the thumbnail index page.

no_count.description: Omit the image count from the captions.

no_slides.description: Omit image slides entirely. Clicking thumbnails goes to plain image files.

watermark_path.description: Path to a watermark image file to overlay on each image. Empty to disable.

url_prefix.description: Base URL prefix for images/slides if index is hosted at a different location.

con_opts.description: Command line options to pass to convert or cjpeg internally.

show_exif.description: Extract and display EXIF tags on image slides.

add_subdir.description: Add links to subdirectories found in the source directory into the index.

tile_height.description: Height in pixels of the tiled image for the film reel effect.

force.description: Force regeneration of thumbnails and slides even if they exist.

chmod_world.description: Make all generated igal2 files world-readable.

caption_gen.description: First run: generate .captions file. Second run: use .captions file.

caption_preserve_name.description: When generating .captions, preserve file names as initial captions.
